title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Factory Orchestration
description:
Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future - with software and data at the core.

Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.

Role

The Intrinsic Factory Experience is an integrated human interface to define, manage, and monitor highly orchestrated factory operations. We build tools to help forward-thinking factories deploy intelligent, flexible manufacturing workflows at scale. Our tools help manufacturing process designers to optimize their resources, factory managers to make sense of their operations, and floor workers to strategically direct their attention.

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Software Engineer to join our dynamic Factory Orchestration team. In this role, you will be responsible for not only developing human-machine user interfaces (HMI), but also optimizing the performance and functionality of client-side rendering, server-side databases, and integration with other backend APIs in Intrinsic. You will develop the full stack of web interfaces for end-to-end factory orchestration tasks and play a vital role in the development of our frontend libraries and components, ensuring a cohesive and user-friendly experience for all customers. The interfaces you build will shape our product and the role of the human in it.

You are excited by the prospect of owning critical pieces of our user experience (including collaborating with the Product and Design teams, and developing tests). You have excellent development skills across the web application stack and are excited to be part of a world-class, innovative, frontend team.

How your work moves the mission forward

• Develop intuitive and innovative interfaces in collaboration with Product, Design, and Engineering teams.

• Own the full stack of the Intrinsic Factory Experience web application, from database design to user interactions.

• Build and maintain the backend logic and infrastructure of the frontend, including server-side functionality and client-side state management.

• Monitor and improve the health (performance, robustness) of the Intrinsic Factory Experience.

Skills you will need to be successful

• At least 3 years of experience with frontend web engineering, including proficiency in building client-side (TypeScript/Javascript) software.

• Extensive experience in building the full-stack, including server-side (Rust, Go, Python, etc.) software.

• Experience with building visually-rich web applications that enable deep user interactions.

• Familiar with integrating databases, user-access control, and basic authentication/authorization into web apps.

• Ability to work with Rust, both for backends and compiled to web assembly for front ends.

Skills that will differentiate your candidacy

• Experience integrating web apps with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and/or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).

• Ability to design scalable web apps.

• Understanding of interface cohesion across a variety of network bandwidths, multiple screen sizes, and differing client-side hardware.

• Experience building dashboards aimed at various user personas.

• Experience with creating and maintaining an intuitive, high quality, accessible system of reusable frontend components in collaboration with Design and Product teams.

The base salary for this full-time position is between $147,200 - $200,900 (USD ) + 15%  bonus + equity + benefits. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your targeted location during the hiring p

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work directly with our largest enterprise customers to understand their needs and build the software that connects Legora to their systems and workflows.

You'll own complex engineering projects from an ambiguous customer request through technical scoping, implementation, and production delivery. Your work will span custom integrations and contributions to Legora's core product. You'll use your technical and product judgment to determine what a customer needs, what we can deliver, and where a solution has value beyond a single engagement.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role within Enterprise Engineering. You'll bring the engineering depth to contribute directly to our core product, alongside the communication and judgment to lead technical delivery with customers. You'll work closely with product engineers, Legal Engineers, and Engagement Managers, taking ownership of technical decisions and implementation.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their systems, workflows, and constraints, translating their needs into clear technical requirements.

- Own engineering delivery from discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and troubleshooting.

- Resolve ambiguity across customer stakeholders and internal teams. Challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs, and align people on a realistic scope and timeline.

- Build integrations between Legora and customer systems, alongside changes to our core product. Identify opportunities to turn customer-specific work into reusable capabilities.

- Manage multiple engagements with a high degree of independence, sequencing work, identifying dependencies, and communicating risks early.

- Diagnose and resolve complex issues where Legora meets a customer's environment, applying sound engineering judgment under time pressure.

- Bring customer insights back into product and engineering decisions, and help develop reusable tooling and engineering practices as the function grows.

WHO YOU ARE

- 5-7+ years of software engineering experience, with recent, hands-on ownership of production software and clear responsibility for technical decisions and delivery.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals. You can independently design, build, test, and ship reliable software, and work effectively in an existing product codebase.

- Comfortable leading technical conversations with customers. You can explain decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and nontechnical stakeholders.

- Experienced in taking ambiguous problems across multiple team

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY
Guidehealth is on a mission to make healthcare affordable for everyone, and Rose, our in-house conversational Automation tools, plays a key role in making sure that everyone who needs access to healthcare can get the attention they need. As Product Manager, you would own the end-to-end lifecycle for Rose, with use cases that range from care management to quality improvement outreach to customer service. Your history of bringing order to complexity, and your willingness to be accountable for outcomes when the path isn't obvious, will help Rose deliver on a simple promise: that every patient is seen, heard, and followed up with. In this role, you sit at the intersection of clinical operations, product development, data science, and software engineering, with the objective of scaling Rose’s capabilities across the organization.
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

• Partner with clinical operations teams (Care Management, Quality, Population Health, Customer Service) to identify, prioritize, and collect requirements for Rose’s use cases.

• Maintain and prioritize use cases, features, and enhancement requests, balancing clinical impact, technical feasibility, and organizational readiness.

• Own the project plan for Rose use cases from requirements through deployment, including timelines, milestones, dependencies, and risk mitigation.

• Ensure timely and clear communication of priorities and activities to leadership and cross-functional partners.

• Analyze performance data to identify trends, surface improvement opportunities, and inform the roadmap.

• Conduct regular call audits to ensure clinical accuracy, HIPAA compliance, appropriate tone, and adherence to approved scripts and conversation flows in partnership with clinical subject matter experts.

• Ensure all use cases comply with applicable healthcare regulations, including HIPAA, CMS, URAC, DiME, and state-specific requirements.

• Facilitate regular program reviews with senior leadership, providing status updates, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations.

• Build strong relationships across the organization to drive adoption and gather continuous feedback.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO HAVE:

• Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing initiatives, manage ambiguity, and deliver measurable outcomes in a complex, cross-functional environment.

• Experience standing up a complex product, shepherding it from development to implementation, and maintaining product integrity through its lifecycle.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into roadmap decisions.

• Proficient with coding languages like Python and SQL , with the ability to query data, review scripts, and collaborate effectively with data and engineering teams.

• Proven ability to execute in real time when plans go sideways: calm under pressure, quick to adjust, and accountable for outcomes regardless of cause.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience.

WOULD LOVE FOR YOU TO HAVE:

• Background that demonstrates iteration as a discipline: refining the same work over multiple cycles (seasons, cohorts, program years, product releases) and treating repetition as a tool for improvement.

• History of applying the qualifications from the previous section in a clinical setting

• Experience building, deploying, or managing conversational AI, voice AI, or LLM-powered products, ideally in a regulated industry.

• Familiarity with AWS-based development tools and Atlassian-based (Jira and Confluence) productivity tools.

• Working knowledge of healthcare regulations and frameworks, including HIPAA, CMS, and state-level compliance requirements.

• Experience in environments where decisions must be documented and defensible to outside scrutiny: audits, accreditation reviews, peer r

title: Designer - Digitalist
description:
The main purpose of the Designer is to work on design-related tasks for Digitalist's assigned clients and projects, with the responsibility to create quality, effective, well-designed, and impactful visual work across websites, e-commerce stores, and paid and owned marketing channels that converts and drives sales for our clients.

As a Designer, you will work closely with Account Managers, developers, and specialists to conceptualize and design a variety of client deliverables. On the web side this means design concepts for WordPress and WooCommerce websites and online stores, landing pages, and conversion-focused UX and UI work that is clean to hand over to development. On the marketing side this means Facebook and Google ad creatives, email marketing designs, content marketing graphics, and social assets, all of which have to express the voice, style, look and feel, and overall design of the brand. This will involve having a deep understanding of clients' visual brand identities, communicating new ideas to the team (verbally and visually), implementing client feedback in your designs, and supporting the team throughout the design and editing process. You will need to be creative while working within the direction of your design briefs.

The Designer will report directly to the Design Lead and the Agency Director, and will also work closely with the development, marketing, and analytics sides of the team to ensure that all designs are created well and on time.
About the Role:
Mission statement:
The primary mission of our Designer is to maintain the high design standards of our company by playing an active role in the design and visual creation process across our range of clients and for our own marketing material.

As our Designer, this will include translating analysis and conversion goals into design concepts for client websites and online stores, designing performance creative and email campaigns that reflect each client's message, brand, and style, coming up with innovative design ideas, and ensuring that your work is of the highest standard and delivered on time. Our web process always starts with the goal of higher conversion and sales, so you will be designing to a commercial outcome rather than to a mood board.
General Responsibilities:

• Creating design concepts for client websites and e-commerce stores (primarily WordPress and WooCommerce), including page templates, product and category pages, checkout flows, and landing pages, using professional design tools (including Figma)

• Preparing clean, well-structured, developer-ready files and handovers, including responsive states, components, spacing, and typography rules, and staying available to the developers through implementation

• Creating high-quality, on-brand creatives for Facebook Ads and Google Ads, including static, motion-lite, and iteration variants for testing

• Designing email marketing campaigns and flows, along with content marketing and social assets, in line with each client's brand identity

• Creating and developing visually pleasing yet marketing-oriented and effective concepts in design

• Working from data and analysis (heatmaps, analytics, tracking findings, test results) and turning that input into design decisions that lift conversion

• Understanding the visual brand identity of various clients and being able to advise your Account Managers on potential design ideas, improvements, and optimizations

• Understanding and communicating design ideas (in writing, verbally, and with the use of visuals) to other team members and, when needed, to clients

• Receiving and implementing feedback and design changes to projects you have worked on

• Assisting Account Managers with all tasks in Figma, including implementing edits and helping to design professional reports when needed

• Being part of a team of both expert and less experienced designers, being able to work as a group when needed, and being able to stick to deadlines and deliver high-q

title: Senior Software Engineer, Bet Engine
description:
PENN Entertainment, Inc. is North America’s leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences. From casinos and racetracks to online gaming, sports betting and entertainment content, we deliver the experiences people want, how and where they want them.

We’re always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting-edge online gaming and sports media products. Whether it’s through Hollywood Casino, theScore Bet Sportsbook, or theScore media app, we’re excited to push the boundaries of what’s possible. These state-of-the-art platforms are powered by proprietary in-house technology, a key component of PENN’s omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy.

When you join PENN Entertainment’s digital team, you’ll not only work on these cutting-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you’ll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We’re committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities.

With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you.

About the TeamAs part of the Bet Engine team, you will be working with a group of talented and friendly individuals. Our goal is to deliver and maintain the performant, resilient, accurate, best-in-class software platform to drive sportsbook wagering, sportsbook grading, casino wagering, financial recordkeeping, data residency, and regulatory enforcement that is at the core of everything we do as a company. As a result, our stakeholders span the entire range of the business, and we must support them with whatever they are required to deliver without sacrificing the quality and performance we strive to maintain. This will include building a lot of cross-service integrations, with internal and external stakeholders. We are also hyper-vigilant about software performance, resilience, reliability, and accuracy, constantly tracking risks and regressions on all fronts, and proposing improvements where opportunities exist. The systems we own are among the most business-critical at PENN: every wager, payout, and ledger entry runs through them, and getting them right is a regulatory obligation, not just an engineering goal.
About the Work

• Design, scale, and performance-tune GraphQL APIs, low-latency gRPC services, and SQL queries powering the sportsbook wagering and grading engine, the casino transaction engine, the financial ledger, responsible gaming enforcement, tax enforcement, general regulatory enforcement, promotional records, and risk management, among other things.

• Own technical problems of the highest scope and complexity, drafting proposals and presenting them to leadership and partner teams for feedback

• Design, architect, and deliver new features end-to-end in a collaborative agile/scrum environment

• Identify bottlenecks and areas of risk in production, and drive the changes that make the platform more scalable

• Set up and refine monitoring and alerting in Datadog for the systems you own

• Mentor engineers on the team and across teams that ship into our codebase, through specs, pairing, and code review

• Interact with multiple stakeholders across a wide variety of business domains to deliver best in class products, operational improvements, and cost efficiency optimizations.

• Be comfortable with bridging the gap between internal, third party, legacy, and modern systems; and excel at doing what this entails, including, data migrations, intermediate data translation, the building and stewardship of additional supporting infrastructure as required, etc.

• Other duties as required.

About You

• You possess a minimum of 5 years of experience in Software engineering

• A solid foundation in computer science, with strong competencies in data structures, distributed systems, algorithms,

title: Sr. Platform Engineer
description:
At EZCORP we are a growing team focused on creating and changing the pawn industry as we know it today. We believe that our platform enabled lending and e-commerce solutions will revolutionize our ability to attract, engage and service our customers across the United States, Mexico and Latin America.
Join us now for an opportunity to be a part of a team that wants to provide access to short-term cash for every person - everywhere!
The Company:
Founded in Austin in 1989, EZCORP has grown into a leading provider of pawn loans in the United States, Mexico and Latin America. We are dedicated to satisfying the short-term cash needs of consumers who are both cash and credit constrained and providing an industry-leading customer experience.
What’s in it for you:
Ground Floor opportunity with EZCORP , a company with a start-up, purpose-driven mentality where innovative and agile problem solving are part of our DNA along with competitive compensation and benefits.
Address:
San Salvador The Senior Platform Engineer will help bridge the present and future. This role will handle current server ops and endpoint engineering responsibilities-managing infrastructure, supporting IaaS, and ensuring endpoint stability-while guiding us toward a platform-centric future. In addition to the day-to-day, this role will champion PaaS, serverless technologies, and self-service capabilities.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Support and optimize existing server ops and endpoint engineering operations.

• Design and implement PaaS and serverless solutions to modernize our platform.

• Develop self-service portals and automation frameworks.

• Collaborate with teams to evolve processes and adopt platform engineering practices.

• Advocate for modernization and support the team’s transition.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

• 5+ years in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering - including hands-on server ops and endpoint management (Intune).

• Deep experience with IaaS (Azure) and at least one major PaaS or serverless platform

• Strong automation background: Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent IaC tooling

• Proven ability to ship self-service tooling that other developers adopt

• Comfortable leading technical direction without formal management authority

• Strong experience in server operations, endpoint engineering, IaaS, and Release Engineering.

• Expertise in PaaS, serverless, and automation technologies.

• Ability to lead, by example, guiding teams into a platform-first mindset.

• Experience with internal developer portals

• Background in platform product thinking - treating internal teams as customers

• Familiarity with FinOps or cloud cost optimization at scale

EZCORP is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Commercial Account Executive (Benelux)
description:
Commercial Account Executive

As an Account Executive (AE) on our Commercial Sales team, you will assist in Datadog’s overall business growth by strategically engaging and closing net-new customers across small to midsize markets. Sellers follow a well-defined methodology, collaborate with internal stakeholders, identify the customer's unique needs, and clearly convey the value of the Datadog product. AEs have the opportunity to grow their careers in Sales and continue contributing to Datadog team success.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

• Focus on net-new logo acquisition via outbound activity

• Become a Datadog expert through continued product and sales trainings

• Manage the full sales cycle, including technical demonstrations and negotiation 

• Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives to drive top of funnel activity

• Strategically prospect into Chief Technology Officers, Engineering/IT Leaders, and technical end-users

Who You Are:

• Curious, driven, and motivated as a sales person

• Creative in how you map and break into accounts

• Able to learn from feedback and champion a growth mindset

• Comfortable operating in a highly technical, fast paced environment

• Experienced in carrying quota, with a proven track record of success

 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

 

Benefits and Growth:

• High income earning opportunities based on self performance

• New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing 

• Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message 

• Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking 

• An inclusive company culture, opportunity to join our Community Guilds

• Generous global benefits

 

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

Every agency that comes onto Axon's platform runs into the same hard problem: decades of fragmented, inconsistent public safety data - case records, CAD history, evidence metadata, camera network configurations, RMS schemas - has to move into a unified, trustworthy foundation without disrupting operations that can't afford downtime. Today, that work is largely bespoke: rebuilt engagement by engagement. We're looking for a technical leader to change that - someone who will fundamentally reinvent how Axon executes data migrations, integrations, and conversions across our Fusus, Records, Standards, e.com, Gravity, and Vision product lines. This is an architecture and engineering leadership role, not a project-management one. We need someone who has built migration platforms, not just run migration projects, and who can turn a historically services-heavy discipline into a repeatable, tooled, scalable engineering capability.

Your Day To Day

• Owns the technical architecture and execution strategy for data migrations, conversions, and integrations across Fusus, Records, Standards, Gravity, and Vision - replacing ad hoc, engagement-by-engagement approaches with reusable frameworks, connectors, and tooling.

• Partners closely with Product and R&D to build, influence, and execute roadmap changes so migration/integration complexity is designed into new products rather than absorbed downstream by services.

• Defines and enforces data governance, security, and chain-of-custody requirements for sensitive public safety and criminal justice data throughout migration and integration workflows.

• Builds a clear build-vs-buy point of view on migration/integration tooling - evaluating platforms such as Informatica, MuleSoft, Fivetran, Databricks/Snowflake, Palantir Foundry, and Boomi - and makes the call on what to build in-house vs. license.

• Establishes KPIs for migration/conversion velocity, data quality, defect rates, and time-to-go-live, and drives them down systematically.

• Builds, mentors, and scales a team of data engineers, integration engineers, and solution architects; establishes career paths and technical leveling for a discipline that has historically been treated as a services function rather than an engineering one.

• Partners with PSO delivery leadership, Sales, and the Mission Engineering/Operator team to align migration/integration capacity and pricing with customer commitments.

• Stays current on data platform tooling, AI-assisted mapping/transformation, and public-safety interoperability standards to keep Axon's approach ahead of the market.

title: Partner Manager, AI Native Ecosystems
description:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies - from scrappy startups to global brands - use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.
About the role
Hi, my name is Marc, VP of Global Partnerships at Customer.io . A new wave of AI SaaS builders - Lovable, Vercel, Cursor, Bolt, and others - is becoming the default starting point for how software gets built, and each one is standing up its own marketplace or integration directory to connect what people build inside them to real backend services.
I'm hiring a Partner Manager, AI Native Ecosystems to make Customer.io the obvious, pre-integrated messaging and engagement layer for everything built on these platforms. This role sits at the intersection of business development and technical integration work: part of the job is identifying and recruiting the right platforms and negotiating partnership terms; the other part is working hands-on with our Product team to scope and ship the actual integration required to get listed and featured.
AI builder platforms are becoming a new front door for software creation - and a new distribution channel for infrastructure providers. Getting Customer.io natively integrated and well-positioned across this ecosystem now, while the partner programs and technical standards are still forming, is a land-grab opportunity. This role owns that land-grab end to end.
What we value

•
Bias to Action: comfortable building the process, not just executing an existing one - these marketplaces and their rules are new and changing monthly.

•
Cross-Functional Fluency: equally credible in a deal negotiation and a technical scoping conversation with engineers.

•
Ownership: drives a relationship from first contact through signed agreement through shipped integration, without waiting to be handed the next step.

•
Resourcefulness: comfortable operating without a dominant brand - you're earning the meeting, not getting it by default.

What you’ll do

•
Immediate priority: optimize our existing Claude and ChatGPT integrations, including MCP discoverability and GEO (making sure Customer.io shows up when AI tools recommend a messaging/engagement platform).

• Identify and prioritize which AI builder platforms (Vercel, Cursor, Lovable, Bolt, Google, AWS, and others) are worth partnering with, working with Engineering, Design, and Product to assess technical feasibility and distribution potential, including CLI and MCP connector priorities.

• Own the full partner relationship lifecycle - outbound, negotiation, and ongoing management - from first contact through signed agreement through shipped integration.

• Negotiate commercial terms (revenue share, co-marketing, marketplace listing requirements) directly with partner and BD counterparts.

• Translate each marketplace's technical requirements into a spec and work hands-on with our engineering team to scope and ship the integration - you don't need to write the integration yourself, but you need to be fluent enough to unblock it.

• Get Customer.io listed, verified, and ideally featured in each platform's marketplace or directory, and manage the relationship as review guidelines and requirements evolve.

• Track installs, activations, and pipeline sourced from each marketplace; report on which partnerships are driving real usage versus which need renegotiation or deprioritization.

• Build the playbook as you go - there's no existing process for this at Customer.io yet, and part of the job is creating repeatable criteria (target criteria, technical requirements checklist, deal template) so new platforms can be evaluated and onboarded quickly.

What we're looking for

• 5-7 years in business development, partnerships, or platform/ecosystem roles, ideally with a developer tools, API-first, or marketplace-driven

title: Electrical Technician (Power Generation) - Memphis
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Power Generation team is seeking an Electrical Technician to operate and maintain plant electrical systems at SpaceX’s power generation facility. You will work hands-on across medium-voltage generation, distribution, and balance-of-plant electrical equipment up to 13.5 kV and 34.8 kV. This is an operations and maintenance role - you will switch, troubleshoot, repair, and keep electrical systems online in a high-reliability, fast-paced plant environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Perform operations and maintenance on plant electrical systems, including generators, transformers, switchgear, motor control centers, motors, VFDs, UPS units, automatic transfer switches, and emergency/black-start equipment, at voltages up to 13.5 kV and 34.8 kV.

• Execute switching, isolation, LOTO, racking of breakers, and restoration of medium-voltage equipment in accordance with plant procedures and NFPA 70E.

• Troubleshoot electrical faults on power distribution, protection, grounding, lighting, and auxiliary systems using one-line diagrams, schematics, and electrical test equipment.

• Perform preventive and predictive maintenance, inspections, and repairs to improve reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

• Support plant startups, shutdowns, outages, and commissioning activities alongside operators, controls technicians, and engineers.

• Install, terminate, and maintain plant electrical equipment, cable, and control wiring as required for operations and maintenance work.

• Respond to electrical alarms, trips, and equipment failures; support root-cause investigations and implement corrective actions.

• Coordinate with operations, engineering, and utility personnel on switching, clearances, and electrical work that affects plant generation.

• Maintain accurate work orders, switching records, and as-found/as-left documentation.

• Follow all safety, LOTO, arc-flash, and PPE requirements while working in energized and hazardous plant environments.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 3+ years of experience as an electrical technician, industrial electrician, or similar role maintaining industrial or power generation electrical systems.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience operating and maintaining medium-voltage electrical systems (4.16 kV to 34.8 kV), including switchgear, transformers, and breakers.

• Experience in a power plant, generating station, or other high-reliability industrial facility.

• Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, electrical schematics, and equipment O&M manuals.

• Experience with LOTO, switching procedures, and NFPA 70E / arc-flash safety practices.

• Experience troubleshooting motors, VFDs, MCCs, UPS systems, and plant auxiliary electrical equipment.

• Familiarity with electrical test equipment (multimeters, insulation testers, infrared, and similar).

• Journeyman electrician license or equivalent formal electrical training.

• Experience using a CMMS or work-order system to plan and close maintenance work.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a multi-discipline operations and maintenance team.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

title: Edge Compute Engineer
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Edge Compute Engineer to join the Latvia Design Center as the primary owner of our ground-segment compute and storage stack running the edge workloads running across all AST ground gateway stations. The Edge Compute Engineer owns the design, provisioning, and lifecycle of this platform across the full gateway fleet globally.

This is a design-and-operate role for a senior engineer who can define the edge compute reference architecture, build an IaC-driven fleet management stack, and take hands-on operational ownership. As the fleet scales, this role will also shape the edge compute platform for future edge functions beyond the current scope.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and own the edge compute reference architecture: virtualization platform (VMware-based virtualization or Kubernetes), VM/container topology, storage layout, virtual networking, and resource governance across the gateway fleet

• Design the platform to support confirmed edge workloads with headroom and architectural provision for deployment of future edge workloads

• Maintain architecture documentation, platform design records, and operational runbooks

• Build and maintain Terraform-based provisioning pipelines and PXE/TFTP-based boot and instance management for consistent, repeatable gateway node deployment

• Implement Ansible-based configuration management and GitOps workflows to enforce auditable configuration state across all hypervisor nodes remotely

• Manage virtualization cluster operations (VMware-based virtualization or Kubernetes): VM/pod lifecycle, HA, storage pools, virtual networking, and patching automation

• Maintain platform-level observability integrated into the central Prometheus/Grafana/VictoriaMetrics stack and support capacity planning as the fleet expands

• Enforce OS hardening baselines, PKI/certificate lifecycle (IAM Roles Anywhere, mTLS), encrypted storage, and firewall rules aligned with AST’s security governance

• Coordinate with on-site teams or vendors for server firmware, BIOS, and RAID configuration as needed; maintain accurate hardware and software inventory across the fleet

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent professional experience.

Experience:

A minimum of 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in infrastructure or platform engineering, with a strong focus on hypervisor administration, Linux systems, and infrastructure-as-code. Demonstrated experience designing and operating distributed or edge compute environments.

• Deep hands-on VMware-based virtualization or Kubernetes (K8s) - cluster management, HA/DRS, virtual networking, storage pools

• Advanced administration (RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian) - systemd, network stack tuning, performance profiling, security hardening

• Terraform for infrastructure provisioning; PXE/TFTP-based boot and instance management; fleet-scale state management

• Ansible and GitOps workflows for drift-free, pipeline-driven configuration enforcement

• Cisco/Juniper networking (switching/routing), VLANs, VPN (IPsec/WireGuard), PrivateLink/private connectivity, last-mile network management, firewall management

• AWS hybrid cloud - Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, PrivateLink integration with on-premises infrastructure

• Certificate lifecycle management, mTLS, IAM Roles Anywhere, access control for production edge infrastructure

• Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics - hypervisor and VM health

title: Staff Software Build Engineer
description:
Primary Function of Position:
The Software Build team at Intuitive is seeking a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to design, build, and operate the next-generation unified build system across all robotic surgery platforms.
This role is for a senior engineer who writes code, debugs real build failures, prototypes infrastructure, and scales systems through direct technical contribution. You will own core build architecture while remaining deeply involved in implementation-driving measurable improvements in build speed, correctness, and developer productivity across large, safety-critical C/C++ codebases.

Roles and Responsibilities:

• Design, implement, and maintain Bazel-based build systems for large-scale C/C++ embedded software, including custom toolchains and cross-compilation flows.

• Directly implement and optimize Bazel Remote Caching and Remote Execution (RBE) to enable fast, deterministic builds across local, CI, and cloud environments.

• Write production code in Rust, C/C++, and Python to support build tooling, infrastructure services, and developer workflows.

• Own and evolve build performance: cache hit rates, execution parallelism, dependency hygiene, hermeticity, and reproducibility.

• Build and maintain developer-facing tooling that improves local iteration speed and CI reliability.

• Integrate and operate build infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments, balancing performance, security, and cost.

• Work directly with firmware, platform, and application teams to debug real-world build issues and eliminate systemic bottlenecks.

• Improve observability of build systems through metrics, logging, and analytics.

• Mentor engineers through code reviews, architectural discussions, and hands-on problem solving.

• Act as a technical advocate for modern build practices and scalable development workflows.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

• Deep technical ownership with a bias toward implementation and measurable outcomes.

• Ability to balance architectural rigor with pragmatic delivery.

• Builds trust through technical credibility and consistent execution.

• Drives alignment by connecting build system improvements to developer productivity and product velocity.

• Acts as a hands-on technical leader shaping the long-term evolution of Intuitive ’s development platforms.

•
10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong record of hands-on technical ownership .

• Deep, practical expertise with Bazel in complex C/C++ and embedded environments .

• Proven experience implementing and operating Bazel Remote Caching and Remote Execution at scale.

• Strong programming experience in Rust, C/C++, and Python .

• Experience debugging and optimizing distributed build systems, CI pipelines, and build infrastructure under real production constraints.

• Solid understanding of compiler toolchains, linkers, and build graph behavior.

• Familiarity with BuildBuddy (or similar Bazel observability / remote execution platforms).

• Exposure to REAPI-compatible execution backends and remote build infrastructure.

• Experience supporting safety-critical or regulated software systems (medical, automotive, aerospace).

• Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science or related field.

12-15 years of relevant industry experience.

title: Software Engineer II, OSS
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Temporal is looking for a Software Engineer II to join the Open Source Server team. This team builds and maintains the core Temporal server. Its scope is broad, including Matching, Applications, Foundations, task processing, quotas and throttling, visibility, developer-facing primitives such as standalone activities, schedules, and streaming, and workflow experience improvements such as Continue-As-New, pause, and reset. We do not expect one person to cover all of these areas. We’re looking for an engineer who is excited to learn the system, contribute to new and/or ambiguous projects across the codebase, and help improve the reliability, performance, operability, and developer experience of Temporal over time. This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll collaborate with experienced engineers to design, build, and operate components of Temporal’s distributed systems platform while growing your skills in distributed systems engineering.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Design, implement, test, and ship well-scoped features and improvements for the Temporal server with support from teammates.

• Work on distributed systems problems in areas such as task matching, scheduling, workflow execution, visibility, quotas, throttling, persistence, developer primitives, and workflow lifecycle features.

• Make thoughtful engineering tradeoffs with guidance, balancing developer experience, performance, and operability requirements.

• Partner with engineers, product managers, cloud teams, and customer-facing teams to understand requirements and deliver scalable solutions.

• Improve the reliability and operability of the server by adding tests, instrumentation, dashboards, alerts, runbooks, and documentation.

• Participate in design discussions and code reviews to learn best practices and contribute to a high-quality codebase.

• Contribute to improving the developer experience for open source users and enterprise customers through incremental improvements and bug fixes.

• Share knowledge with teammates and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

• Experience building and operating production backend systems (distributed systems experience and concurrency experience).

• Strong computer science fundamentals, including concurrency basics, data structures, and debugging.

• Experience writing production-quality code in Go, Java, or another applicable backend language, with an emphasis on correctness and maintainability.

• Familiarity with core distributed systems concepts (e.g., fault tolerance, consistency tradeoffs, replication, scheduling, performance), with interest in deepening these skills.

• Ability to break down ambiguous problems into smaller tasks, ask good questions, and incorporate feedback from code review.

• Comfort working collaboratively across teams and communicating progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly.

• Experience with testing practices and an operational mindset (logging, metrics, tracing, on-call empathy) is a plus.

• Experience with open source software or communities is a plus.

• Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.

• Exposure to technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, Cassandra, PostgreSQL, or MySQL is a plus.

• Exposure to Kubernetes or related tooling (CRDs, KEDA, Argo) is a plus.

WHAT MAKES YOU A GOOD FIT

• You’re excited to continue building and deepening your distributed systems expertise.

• You enjoy learning large, complex codebases, think critically, thrive in ambiguity, and enjoy solving challenging problems.

• You take ownership of your work, follow through, and collaborate well with teammates.

• You balance technical depth with practical engineering decisions and are comfortable iterating toward better solutions.

• You don’t need prior Temporal experience-you’re excited to work on the core of a distributed system used by a large open source community and enterprise customers.

Job Summary:

We are seeking skilled and detail-oriented Avionic Technicians to support the assembly and integration of avionics systems within our satellite production line. The primary focus will be on harness dressing, routing, securing of wire harnesses, and the installation of avionics components in accordance with aerospace standards and engineering documentation.

Key Responsibilities:

• Perform harness dressing, including routing, lacing, shielding, and clamping of cables and harnesses within spacecraft modules.

• Install avionics equipment (boxes, heaters, RTDs, connectors) following interface control documents (ICDs) and installation drawings.

• Interpret and work from electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, installation drawings, and work instructions.

• Ensure compliance with IPC/WHMA-A-620, NASA-STD-8739.4, and company quality standards.

• Use tools such as torque drivers, wire strippers, crimpers, heat guns, and harness forming boards.

• Perform point-to-point continuity checks and support in-process quality inspections.

• Maintain cleanroom protocols and electrostatic discharge (ESD) controls during assembly operations.

• Document work performed and report any non-conformances (NCRs) to engineering and quality teams.

• Collaborate closely with engineering, quality, and integration teams to resolve technical issues.

Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification in avionics or aerospace assembly preferred.

• 2+ years experience in avionics harnessing, preferably in aerospace or satellite manufacturing.

• Proficient with harness dressing standards and practices in aerospace environments.

• Familiarity with CIRRIS or similar harness testing systems is a plus.

• IPC/WHMA-A-620 or NASA workmanship certification is highly desirable.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring schematics, and work instructions.

• Strong attention to detail, manual dexterity, and commitment to quality.

• Willingness to work in a cleanroom environment with PPE as required.

Preferred Experience:

• Previous experience in Aerospace, Avionics, LEO satellite assembly, avionics bay integration, or flight hardware installations is desired.

• Hands-on experience with bonded connectors, backshell assembly, EMI shielding, and bracket installations.

• Understanding of configuration control and traceability in space-grade production environments.

• Must be able to work in either 1 st shift, 2 nd shift or 3 rd shift or the weekends as required.

• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods of time.

• Ability to use hands and fingers to perform repetitive and precision tasks.

• Ability to climb, balance, bend, stoop, kneel, and reach as required to perform job duties.

• Ability to communicate effectively, including talking and hearing.

• Ability to work in, on, around, and in proximity to large structures, equipment, and tooling.

• Ability to lift, push, and/or carry items up to 15 pounds as required.

• Ability to work near moving mechanical parts and equipment.

title: Semi-Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
description:
Semi-Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
Full-time contractor · Fully remote · Latin America only

Cloudnonic is an international, fully remote cloud and software company. We build customized cloud-native systems for clients in Europe and North America, and we're looking for a Semi-Senior QA engineer to join the team.

Who we are

Cloudnonic Corp . is a digitally native software and cloud startup based in the Kitchener/Waterloo area, Ontario, Canada. We're fully remote, with developers in Canada and South America and clients across Europe, North America, and South America. We work across healthcare, finance, construction, and manufacturing, and we take the time to understand each client's industry so we can serve it well with technology.

We're big on AI and the cloud. Our services range from app and web development to AI and cloud integration, plus technology consulting: designing feasible, secure, cost-effective architectures for non-technical clients and advising them on their tech stack.

The role

You'll test across multiple client projects, each with its own platform, users, and quirks. You'll need to understand a new platform quickly and see it the way its end users do: what they expect, where they get confused, and what breaks when they do something nobody planned for.

We ship weekly, from development to staging to production. You'll be the quality gate in between. That includes regression testing: running the same core flows release after release, carefully, every time. If repetition bores you, this isn't the right fit. If you see it as the job that protects users, it is.

We deliver AI-first. AI generates our tickets and acceptance criteria, we pair with AI while developing, and every pull request goes through AI review before a senior engineer reviews it. That makes us fast, and it makes QA more important, not less. We expect you to use AI to generate test cases, draft scripts, and speed up automation, and to know where it falls short: an AI-written test can pass while missing the bug a real user would hit. You need to judge whether a test actually proves something. If you can only run the tests an AI wrote for you, this isn't the role for you.

You'll work closely with developers and project managers, and you'll keep moving our testing forward by adopting new automation tools as they appear. Expect to be challenged constantly, and to enjoy the work along the way.

What you'll do

• Test new features and bug fixes across multiple client projects before they reach production

• Run regression testing on core user flows for every release

• Write clear test cases and test scripts based on acceptance criteria

• Build and maintain automated tests using modern tools, including AI-powered testing tools

• Report bugs with precise reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, and evidence

• Evaluate features from the end user's perspective and flag usability issues, not only functional ones

title: Senior Financial Services[#2074]
description:
EGYM Financial Services is growing fast - and now we are taking it to the United States. We are looking for a Senior Financial Services - USA, based in Denver, to build our leasing & financing business in the US market from the ground up.

This is a true greenfield build with a commercial heart. EGYM's technology business in the US is scaling, and Financial Services is the lever that turns one-off equipment purchases into monthly rates. There is no playbook yet - you will write it. You open doors with US banks and leasing partners, win over our own EGYM Technology Sales team, and convince customers that financing is the smarter way to buy. It takes a hands-on, growth-minded builder who stays persistent - because this is a story you have to sell on three fronts at once: to the banks, to our sales team, and to our customers. If you love shaping something from a blank page - you don't wait for the phone to ring, you pick it up first.

YOUR DAILY WORKOUT

• Build the US business from the ground up: You establish and grow EGYM's Vendor Financing business in the United States - from partner acquisition and program design through deal structuring, contract closing and portfolio monitoring. There is no existing volume; your mandate is to create it.

• Build the banking network: You identify, win and onboard US financial partners, and negotiate the framework programs and terms that let the business scale. This is a bank- and partner-driven build, so you spend real time getting close to how lenders think, decide and price.

• Make financing a sales driver: You work shoulder-to-shoulder with the EGYM Technology Sales team and US leadership to embed Financial Services into how they sell

• Set up the operational backbone: You establish the internal processes and hand-offs between Order Management, Accounting and Sales so that financed deals flow smoothly from quote to contract to revenue - clean, compliant and scalable.

• Own it and win everyone for the mission: You are the persistent champion for financing - convincing banks to back the program, our own sales team to lead with it, and customers to choose it. You keep pushing until financing is simply how EGYM sells in the US.

• Active market presence: You show up where the business is - with partners, the Technology Sales team, key customers, at EGYM events and at industry events such as HFA (Health & Fitness Association).

• Build the structure to scale: You design the workflows, contracts and controls that let this business scale, and keep our data clean, current and reliable. As volume grows, you build and lead the team around it.

YOUR FITNESS LEVEL

• Equipment finance experience: You bring 7-10+ years in equipment finance, leasing or an equivalent role with a clear understanding of how sales-financing drives commercial growth. A background in vendor finance is ideal.

• At home in the banking world: You have worked in or closely alongside the banking and financial-services sector and understand how banks and leasing companies operate, decide and price. Experience in a banking environment is a must for this role.

• A network that opens doors: Established industry relationships and a referral network among US banks, leasing companies and equipment-finance partners would be much appreciated and give you a real head start.

• Builder's track record: You have hands-on commercial, sales or business development experience and know how to build a pipeline, structure programs and close. You are comfortable creating something from nothing rather than managing something that already runs.

• Growth & hands-on mindset: You are growth-minded and hands-on - you enjoy the room to shape and design, roll up your sleeves, and get things done without waiting for a process to exist.

• Persistence & persuasion: You are persistent and resilient. You can sell the same new idea again and again - to banks, to internal sales teams and to customers - without losing energy or conviction.

The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

title: Campaign Lead EMEA
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Position Summary

The Campaign Lead is a senior role within the Market Development Capability Area, responsible for owning and driving complex customer opportunities from early shaping through to contract award. You will develop and lead the campaign strategy, bringing together expertise from across Metrea to understand customer requirements, develop differentiated solutions and position the business to win.   

The primary focus will be on campaigns in manned airborne ISR, Air Transport and Aerial Fire Fighting, with the potential to integrate Metrea’s Electromagnetic & Cyber and Digital & Synthetic capabilities into solutions. You will have a deep understanding of Air domain effects, sensors and capabilities, the missions they are employed within and the markets and customers that require them. Based from our London office with hybrid working, you will be responsible for developing and delivering winning campaigns from early shaping and campaign planning through bid submission, contract award and transition to delivery, supporting national security customers including the UK Ministry of Defence, NATO and allied partners.  

You will work closely with Market Development leads and teams across Metrea, bringing together the operational, technical, commercial and delivery expertise required to develop and execute successful campaign strategies across the EMEA region. Working closely with the Bids & Proposals team, you will provide strategic and content leadership for complex bids and proposals. You will develop the win strategy, value proposition and key messages, translate technical and operational inputs into compelling customer-focused content and ensure the campaign strategy is consistently reflected through the proposal.  You will be trained in the Metrea Solution Framework and, after contract award, will work with Programme Leads to ensure the customer need is delivered and to identify opportunities to grow our services.

What You'll Do

• Lead campaign activity from early customer engagement and opportunity shaping through solution development, bid generation and contract award

• Lead customer, market and competitive analysis, including stakeholder mapping, customer needs, procurement intelligence and competitor positioning, to inform the campaign strategy

• Develop and execute customer and stake

title: Mortgage Operations Analyst
description:
Mortgage Operations Analyst

Location: India (Remote) | Hours: EST
AHL + Saaf AI
Saaf AI is building the AI workforce for the mortgage industry. Saaf AI is part of American Heritage Lending (AHL), a top-10 private lender processing billions in loan volume with 15+ years of mortgage origination expertise. Together, we are combining AHL's proven lending operations with the power of AI-native innovation to redefine what's possible in mortgage lending. We are backed by some of the largest asset managers and funds and are growing fast.
We're not experimenting with AI. We're deploying it - from underwriting to document processing to borrower experience.
About the Role
Saaf AI is hiring a Mortgage Operations Analyst to join our growing U.S. mortgage operations team. In this role, you will review and support residential mortgage loan files across the full loan lifecycle - from initial disclosures and processing through closing and post-close - to ensure accuracy, completeness, compliance, and adherence to investor and lender guidelines.
This is a hands-on operations role, not a passive audit function. You will work inside the loan file, validate borrower documentation, surface discrepancies, calculate income and assets, resolve underwriting conditions (including those flagged by AI-driven underwriting systems), and collaborate with processing, underwriting, closing, and post-closing teams. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can work independently in a remote environment.
Key Responsibilities

• Review residential mortgage loan files at every stage of the loan lifecycle, including pre-closing and post-close.

• Validate borrower documentation: income (W-2, self-employed, bank statement, DSCR), assets, credit, collateral, and supporting documents.

• Calculate qualifying income across different documentation types and validate reserves and source of funds.

• Review and prepare Initial Disclosures for accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.

• Identify missing documentation, data discrepancies, compliance gaps, and process issues - and resolve them with the right stakeholders.

• Respond to and clear underwriting conditions, including those flagged by AI-driven underwriting systems.

• Work directly inside Encompass LOS to review, update, and validate loan information; manage milestones and order services.

• Communicate clearly with internal teams and, where required, with borrowers to collect outstanding documentation.

• Document findings and actions accurately in internal systems.

• Contribute to continuous process improvement and quality assurance efforts.

Required Qualifications

• 2+ years of hands-on U.S. mortgage operations experience across processing, underwriting support, loan review, closing, or post-close functions.

• Working knowledge of the full U.S. residential mortgage loan process - not pigeonholed into a single task or document type.

• Hands-on experience with Encompass LOS (required - will be validated in a live test).

• Familiarity with mortgage documentation, disclosures, and loan file review.

• Ability to calculate income across different employment types (wage-earner, self-employed, bank statement) and validate assets and reserves.

• Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and problem-solving mindset.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills - must comprehend complex instructions and communicate clearly with U.S.-based teams.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.

• Ability to manage multiple loan files independently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Exposure to Non-QM, DSCR, or RTL loan products (priority).

• Exposure to Agency, Government, or Conventional loan products.

• Experience reviewing Initial Disclosures and mortgage compliance documentation.

• Understanding of TRID, RESPA, TILA, or other mortgage regulatory frameworks (a plus, not required).
